title: fix(plugin-detail): the activity feed names the record as the reader reads it when the object is named by a formula
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMF4rV72CDoWfEYjfxmXjCu)_
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVKbmZ6tBvw9qv8rir

Fixes #29962
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页的动态（活动面板、动态 tab、动态小面板）里，活动摘要引号中的记录名，现在按读者的语言显示，与记录页标题一致。只对「名称字段是公式」的对象生效（例如 `label(record.status) + ' · ' + record.name`）。
- **为什么改**：服务端在写入时把记录名按写入者语言存进 `sys_activity.record_label` 和 `summary`；读取时虽按读者语言重组整句，但记录名仍是写入者那份。中文用户创建的记录，英文读者看到 `Created Project "计划中 · Atlas Rollout"`，而标题是 `Active · Atlas Rollout`。
- **风险与回滚**：纯前端读时替换，不动数据、不动服务端、不动元数据。名称字段是普通文本的对象完全不变（改名不改写旧记录）。代价：公式名对象的旧动态显示的是记录「现在」的名字（例如创建时是「计划中」，现在显示「Active」），与标题同源。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts` 的 `readerRecordNameOf` / `withReaderRecordName`（规则本身）；`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` 顶部那段 `useMemo`（唯一接入点）；新测试文件。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordActivityTimeline.readerRecordName-29962.test.tsx`，预期 14 条全绿；或看下方前后截图。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The record page's activity feed names the page record as the reader reads it, for an object whose name field is a formula. **This is the read-time ui half; no server read is changed** (triage 6612785923 asked the PR to say which side resolves the name).

Measured first, how a row's text is composed: plugin-audit stores `summary` and `record_label` at write time; on read, `installActivitySummaryLocale` re-composes `summary` in the reader's language from the code stored in `metadata` (`activityCreated` / `activityUpdated` / `activityUpdatedFields` / `activityDeleted`), but the code's `label` parameter is the stored writer-language text, and the code is stripped from what a non-system reader is served. So the ui receives a reader-language sentence that quotes the writer's name, plus `record_label` (the same text) and `record_id`.

- `activityRowToFeedItem` (`renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`) carries the row's `record_id` and `record_label` onto the item as a package-local hand-off (`ActivityRecordFacts`, the same pattern as `recordTimelineStream.ts`'s `AuditFeedFacts`), so both readers of `sys_activity` (the record page's own feed read and the `record:activity` block's self-fetch) carry it. No `@object-ui/types` member is added.
- `readerRecordNameOf(objectSchema, record, recordId)`: the value of the object's name field (`resolveNameField`, the ADR-0079 ladder plugin-audit titles the row by) on the record the page read, which is the H1's name, answered only when that field is a `formula`.
- `withReaderRecordName(items, reader)`: for each item of the page record whose stored name the summary quotes (`"…"`, or `「…」` for ja-JP), replaces the first quoted occurrence with the reader's name. Returns the input array when nothing changes.
- `RecordActivityTimeline` applies it once, at the top, from the `RecordContextProvider` it already reads for field labels, so the panel, the stream (动态 tab) and the peek (动态 panel) all draw the reader's name.

## Why

hotclm names four child objects with a formula `display_name` over `label(record.FIELD)` (#26608), so toasts, related lists and the H1 follow the reader's locale; the activity panel did not.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordActivityTimeline.readerRecordName-29962.test.tsx`, 14 tests, real subjects `activityRowToFeedItem` + `RecordActivityTimeline` under `RecordContextProvider`:

- en-US reader of a zh-CN writer's row reads the H1's name, in the `panel`, `stream` and `peek` variants; a system update in zh-CN; a ja-JP `「…」` summary.
- Kept as stored: an object named by a text field (a rename does not rewrite older rows), a row of another record, no record context, a record with an empty name.
- Pure half: `readerRecordNameOf` answers formula name fields only; `readerRecordSummary` touches only the first quoted name (an unquoted field-change value equal to the name is left); `withReaderRecordName` returns the same array when nothing changes.

**Positive control on main** (src files at `fdd06415`, test file kept): 9 failed / 5 passed; the 5 DOM tests that assert the reader's name are among the 9 (the other 4 are the pure tests, whose exports do not exist on main).

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `readerRecordId !== undefined && readerRecordName !== undefined` → `false` in `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): 5 failed / 9 passed, exactly the five reader-name DOM tests. The test file imports the timeline by relative path and the ui vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to source, so no `dist/` is involved.

## Acceptance notes

- **Current name, not name-at-the-time, for formula names.** The replacement is the record's name now, as the H1 shows it (the issue's "resolve the name at read time when the object's name field is a formula"). A formula whose inputs changed since the row was written shows the current composition: in the evidence below, the `created` row reads `"Active · Atlas Rollout"` although the project was created `planned`. A stored (non-formula) name field is not touched, so a renamed record's older rows keep their old name, as before.
- **Scope is the record page's feed.** Other surfaces that draw `sys_activity.summary` (a user's home/My Work feed in `app-shell`, Setup dashboards) still show the stored name; they have no page record to name it by. A fully per-reader name everywhere is the server half (store the record reference and render the label on read), `domain:server`'s, outside this card.
- A fired milestone's author template is not quoted by the platform templates; if it quotes the stored name the same way, it is replaced too; otherwise left.
- Branch name is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-d97x01`, not `claude/issue-29962-…` (Duplicate Fix Guard). The two `chore(evidence)` commits add and then remove the screenshots below; the squash merge carries neither.

## Verification

Head `8f4210c8` (the fix is `736d4ace`; the two later commits add and remove evidence only, net diff identical).

Screenshots, real stack (`examples/app-showcase` with a formula name patched in, `os dev --seed-admin`, the Console dev server proxied to it; zh-CN writer through REST, en-US browser reader; how it was rendered: `evidence/29962/README.md` at the evidence commit):

| before (main behaviour, timeline wiring ablated) | after (this branch) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c86b862fb4208322b4a7642423309e2e253e9ad3/evidence/29962/before-en-US.png?raw=true) | ![after](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/c86b862fb4208322b4a7642423309e2e253e9ad3/evidence/29962/after-en-US.png?raw=true) |

Served on that stack to an en-US reader: `summary` `Created Project "计划中 · Atlas Rollout"` with `record_label` `计划中 · Atlas Rollout`, and the record's `display_name` `Active · Atlas Rollout`.
